card.name: Boxed warning headline: RISK OF SERIOUS
card.fires_on: The ending of SERIOUS in the all-caps boxed warning heading "RISK OF SERIOUS ...". It also fires on "the" in title-like phrases such as "Inside the Body" or "History of the deeds".

modes.label: Boxed warning heading
modes.description: The last piece of SERIOUS in the capitalized heading "WARNING: RISK OF SERIOUS" just before the named risk.
modes.example: WARNING: RISK OF SER<<IOUS>> INFECTIONS Patients treated with KEV

modes.label: The in titles
modes.description: The word "the" inside a book or article title, before a noun like Body or deeds.
modes.example: Molecular Imaging: Seeing Cancer in Action Inside<< the>> Body Oct. 8,

card.writes: It promotes title-like nouns such as Work, Event, Body and Story, and suppresses attribute words such as Type, Grade, Number and Level.
card.plain: It marks the point in a heading or title where a noun is about to come, like the risk named after "RISK OF SERIOUS".
